Sub: Draft Recruitment Rules to the posts of Chief Engineer, Executive Engineer
(Civil), Executive Engineer (Electrical), Assistant Executive Engineer (Civil),
Assistant Executive Engineer (Electrical) and Junior Engineer (Civil / Electrical)
in EPFO — regarding.

Sir,

Tam directed to place the Recruitment Rules for the posts of Chief Engineer, Executive
Engineer (Civil), Executive Engineer (Electrical), Assistant Executive Engineer (Civil), Assistant
Executive Engineer (Electrical) and Junior Engineer (Civil / Electrical) on the website of EPFO for
a period of 30 days for seeking comments of the stakeholders on the draft RR in terms of
DoP&T O.M. No. AB-14017/61/2008-Estt. (RR) dated 13.10.2015.

2. In this regard, it is requested to bring the above draft RRs to the notice of the
concerned officials of your jurisdiction so that they can provide comments on the RRs at the
earliest through email on the ID i.e. re2.hrd@epfindia.gov.in.

[This issues with the approval of Central P.F. Commissioner]

Yours faithfully,

i
